Title: Implement splitbrain_find_symbol tool (find classes/methods by name)
Description: Find classes, functions, methods, or interfaces by name across the codebase using grep/ripgrep (not LLM). Fast, deterministic, exact. Parameters: name, rootPath, language?, symbolType? (class|method|interface|all). Returns list of matches with file path and line number. Does NOT use LLM — pure text search. Complement to search_codebase (which is semantic/fuzzy).
